results.title: Set-up: synthetic WhatsApp channel + one registered requester (WhatsApp on) and one stranger
Handshake: right verify token echoes the challenge; wrong token, wrong mode and a script-like challenge are all refused (403)
Unsigned, wrongly signed and tampered messages are rejected and change nothing
Oversized body (>1 MB) is refused with 413 before it is read
Malformed JSON with a VALID signature gets 200 (no retry storm) and creates nothing
Unknown destination phone-number id (not our channel) is ignored safely; creates nothing
Stranger (number not registered to any user) writing "Hi": no ticket and no conversation is created for them
Registered requester says "Hi": a conversation starts for THAT person; Meta being unreachable does not crash the webhook
results.detail: 200; conversation state "awaiting_service" for the right person

results.title: Replaying the SAME message id is idempotent: no second conversation and no duplicate processing
A one-person conversation is never shared: the stranger cannot read or change the requester's conversation
No secret leaks: webhook responses never contain the app secret, token or verify token
results.detail: no secrets in the response body
